description: This file contains Python source code implementing functions for compiling shared objects, packaging AOTInductor files, and loading AOTI packages related to the PyTorch _inductor package. It manages build configurations, file handling, and integration with PyTorch's custom C++ build system.

methods.name: str compile_so(aoti_dir: str, aoti_files: list[str], so_path: str)
methods.description: Compiles C++ source files into a shared object (.so) file, including handling of build flags, linking, and embedding serialized weights.

methods.name: FileLike package_aoti( archive_file: FileLike, aoti_files: AOTI_FILES, )
methods.description: Packages AOTInductor files into a PT2Archive format.

methods.name: AOTICompiledModel load_package( path: FileLike, model_name: str = "model", run_single_threaded: bool = False, num_runners: int = 1, device_index: int = -1, )
methods.description: Loads a compiled AOTInductor package, supporting different input types such as file paths and in-memory buffers, and returns an AOTICompiledModel.
